items.title: NVIDIA's $279B Supply Commitments: Can These Secure Its Growth Runway?
items.author: Anirudha Bhagat      Thu 24 September 2026 at 9:41 am GMT-4   4 min read
items.highlights: NVIDIA Corporation's NVDA increase in supply and capacity commitments signals confidence in sustained artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure demand. At the end of the second quarter of fiscal 2027, the company had committed $279 billion to secure supply and production capacity, up from $119 billion in the first quarter. Most commitments are tied to memory and manufacturing facilities needed for current and future data center products.
